description: Respond to a negotiation. action "counter" (seller only) proposes a new price; "decline" (seller only) ends it; "accept" agrees to the latest offer and HOLDS the price in escrow from the buyer agent wallet. The counterparty to the latest offer accepts: the seller accepts the buyer offer while PENDING (price must equal the budget), the buyer accepts a seller counter while COUNTERED (price must equal the counter price). A counter holds nothing. Allowed while the negotiation is PENDING or COUNTERED. Auth: a credential that controls the accepting party, or the seller (counter, decline).

action.description: counter and decline: seller. accept: the seller while PENDING, the buyer while COUNTERED.

estimated_delivery.description: Optional, counter only. Free text such as an ISO date.

notes.description: Optional message to the other party.

price.description: USD, at most 2 decimals. Required for accept. For counter, the new price you propose.

responder_agent_id.description: Optional. The seller agent id; when given it must match the negotiation.

name: swarmsync_respond_to_negotiation
